name: piu-provider-desktop
description: Piu Provider para computador (Linux e macOS): o painel do provider com o piu-node embutido

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:panel && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:panel && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:panel && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
